_about: Differences from PolicyEngine UK that we understand and accept, by household id (or * for all) and line. Each needs a reason.

ma-couple-scot-30k.income tax: Marriage Allowance for a Scottish taxpayer. The law gives a fixed cut in tax (Income Tax Act 2007 s55B); for a Scottish taxpayer it's at the Scottish basic rate (s55B(3)), 20% × £1,260 = £252. PolicyEngine instead adds £1,260 to the partner's allowance, which saves tax at their top rate (here 21% on part), £256.74. Outside Scotland the two methods agree for basic-rate taxpayers.
ma-couple-scot-30k.net income: Follows from the income tax difference.
